_about: Curated JWST (and noted Spitzer) atmosphere verdicts for small/rocky exoplanets, for the Cosmic Shoreline view. Names verified against pscomppars pl_name via TAP on 2026-07-12. Verdicts follow the primary literature; single-eclipse results are provisional (see caveats). Curated 2026-07-12.

planets.name: TRAPPIST-1 b
planets.basis: MIRI dayside T_b 503 K near zero-redistribution bare-rock max; thick CO2 ruled out; 2026 phase curve: no nightside emission, no offset, P ≳ 1 bar strongly disfavoured (hazy-CO2 alternative noted 2025)
planets.citation: Greene+ 2023 Nature 618,39; Ducrot+ 2025 Nat.Astron. (arXiv:2412.11627); Gillon+ 2026 Nat.Astron. (arXiv:2509.02128)

planets.name: TRAPPIST-1 c
planets.basis: MIRI eclipse T_b 380 K rules out cloud-free O2/CO2 from 10 bar to 0.1 bar pure CO2; 2026 phase curve disfavours ≳1 bar; tenuous O2-rich or airless remain

planets.name: TRAPPIST-1 d
planets.basis: Flat NIRSpec/PRISM transmission: H2-dominated rejected >3σ; Titan/cloud-free-Venus/early-Mars/Archean/modern-Earth analogs ruled out >95%; thin or aerosol-capped remain

planets.name: TRAPPIST-1 e
planets.basis: DREAMS transits rule out cloudy H2-dominated >3σ, but stellar contamination dominates; bare rock and N2-rich secondary both fit

planets.name: LHS 3844 b
planets.basis: MIRI/LRS eclipse spectrum: dark space-weathered basalt, featureless, matches zero-redistribution bare rock; ~100 mbar CO2 upper limit (confirms Spitzer 2019 phase curve)

planets.name: GJ 1252 b
planets.basis: Spitzer (not JWST): dayside T_b 1410 K matches zero-redistribution bare rock; P < ~10 bar, most CO2 atmospheres ruled out

planets.name: GJ 486 b
planets.basis: MIRI eclipse rules out >~1 bar atmospheres with ≳100 ppm H2O/CO2, against the earlier water-or-starspots transmission slope; thin atmosphere not excluded

planets.name: GJ 367 b
planets.basis: MIRI full phase curve: nightside flux 4±8 ppm, phase amplitude 0.97 — zero-albedo zero-redistribution airless rock

planets.name: GJ 3929 b
planets.basis: Rocky Worlds DDT #1: full 4-eclipse set gives T_b 641 K, consistent with bare rock, but only thick non-inverted CO2 excluded >3σ; thin atmospheres viable

planets.name: 55 Cnc e
planets.basis: NIRCam+MIRI eclipse spectra read as CO/CO2 secondary atmosphere over a magma ocean; contested — strong eclipse-depth variability

planets.name: LTT 1445 A b
planets.basis: MIRI eclipse T_b 525 K ≈ 96% of bare-rock max; ~100 bar A_B>0.08 excluded 3σ, 1–100 bar pure CO2 disfavoured; Mars/Titan/Earth-thickness unresolved

planets.name: GJ 1132 b
planets.basis: MIRI eclipse T_b 709 K (1σ below airless max); ≥1% CO2 ruled out; 4 co-added NIRSpec transits featureless — simplest reading is bare rock

planets.name: TOI-1468 b
planets.basis: Hot Rocks II: T_b 1024 K consistent with zero-albedo airless rock; pure CO2/H2O > 1 bar ruled out

planets.name: L 98-59 b
planets.basis: NIRSpec transits favor SO2-rich volcanic atmosphere at 3.6σ model-level (2.4σ nested) — tentative

planets.name: L 98-59 c
planets.basis: COMPASS: featureless transmission; H2-He primaries and MMW <~10 ruled out 3σ; high-MMW secondary vs airless unresolved

planets.name: L 98-59 d
planets.basis: Transmission retrievals favor high-MMW sulfur-bearing (H2S+SO2) secondary at ~2.3–2.6σ in two analyses; volatile-rich bulk density

planets.name: LHS 1140 b
planets.basis: Clear H2-dominated ruled out; ~2.3σ hint of N2-dominated secondary on a likely water world; more JWST scheduled

planets.name: LHS 1478 b
planets.basis: Hot Rocks I: possible shallow eclipse (would imply atmosphere) but the two visits disagree — inconclusive, follow-up scheduled

planets.name: LHS 1140 c
planets.basis: Hot Rocks III: dayside T_b 561 K vs airless max 537 K; pure CO2 ≥ 10 mbar and H2O ≥ 1 bar ruled out >3σ

planets.name: LTT 3780 b
planets.basis: Hot Rocks IV: dayside ~98% of zero-redistribution max; CO2-bearing atmospheres ruled out to ~0.01 bar

planets.name: GJ 3473 b
planets.basis: Hot Rocks V: eclipse somewhat shallower than dark bare rock; thick CO2 ruled out above ~1.2–6.5 bar; moderate atmosphere and bare rock both consistent

planets.name: TOI-1685 b
planets.basis: NIRSpec phase curve: dayside 0.98±0.07 × airless blackbody; H2-dominated ruled out; featureless in emission + transmission

planets.name: GJ 357 b
planets.basis: COMPASS: featureless; MMW < 8 and metallicity < 300× solar ruled out — CO2-rich secondary vs bare rock unresolved

planets.name: GJ 9827 d
planets.basis: Steam-world: water-dominated high-MMW atmosphere detected (1.98 R⊕ — volatile-rich, borderline rocky)

shorelines.label: Zahnle & Catling 2017 (I_XUV ∝ v_esc⁴)
shorelines.implementation_notes: v_esc = 11.186·sqrt(mass/radius) km/s (Earth units). Convert bolometric→cumulative-XUV with xuv_scaling. Canonical anchor is Mars, NOT Earth (Earth sits ~10× on the retention side).

shorelines.label: Empirical shoreline (Meni-Gallardo & Pallé 2026)
shorelines.implementation_notes: Anchored on Mars + four tentative-atmosphere exoplanets; steeper slope consistent with Berta-Thompson+ 2025 (5.9 +0.61/−0.43). Same axes as zc17_xuv. ARM = 5.77·log10(v_esc) − log10(I_XUV) − 4.35 (>0 ⇒ retention side).

xuv_scaling.formula: I_XUV/I_XUV,⊕ = (S/S⊕) × (L_bol/L_sun)^(−0.6); L/L_sun from st_lum (10^st_lum) or fallback st_rad² × (st_teff/5772)⁴
xuv_scaling.notes: Standard ZC17 cumulative-XUV scaling. For mid/late M dwarfs (M* < 0.35 M_sun) measured fluences run 2.1–3.1× higher (Pass+ 2025, arXiv:2504.01182) — offer a ×2.5 toggle in that regime.
xuv_scaling.citation: Zahnle & Catling 2017, ApJ 843, 122; Pass et al. 2025, ApJL (arXiv:2504.01182)

caveats: TOI-771 b (Rocky Worlds DDT #2): observations executing mid-2026, no published verdict as of 2026-07-12 — show as pending, uncolored.
GJ 1252 b is a Spitzer result (no JWST yet); LHS 3844 b's bare-rock verdict began with Spitzer and was confirmed by JWST in 2026.
Single-eclipse verdicts are systematics-sensitive; 2026 uniform reanalyses shifted several depths by ~1σ (arXiv:2604.15421, arXiv:2507.02052).
Flat transmission alone can never exclude a high-MMW secondary atmosphere — such verdicts are marked ambiguous, not bare-rock.
K2-18 b, LP 791-18 c, GJ 3090 b, Pi Men c, GJ 1214 b are excluded: R > 2 R⊕, not rocky.
